spec.assertion: Asserts a self shield effect / the Delusion-gated buffs are live from frame 0 with no finite expiry. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'windowed shield' model that stamps an expiresFrame, and under any model that omits the status so skill2b never activates.

it.skip — trigger is 'when Delusion status ends'. The v1 boss deals no damage and nothing in the engine breaks a shield, so the block is UNREACHABLE by construction. Must NOT be modelled as an ungated proc.
it.skip — no targeting model exists in the sim (no primitive for 'prevents being targeted'). Purely defensive; zero damage payload. Belongs verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.
it.skip — 'stun' IS a real engine primitive, but it hangs off the unreachable Delusion-Shattered trigger, so it can never fire. Reachability, not a missing primitive.

spec.kitLine: on normal attack while not in Delusion
spec.assertion: it.skip — the 'while NOT in Delusion' gate is never satisfied (Delusion applies at t=0, never ends). Discriminates against the nearest-wrong ungated shotFired re-apply, which would stack a shield every trigger pull.

spec.kitLine: on Burst Skill while not in Delusion
spec.assertion: it.skip — same gate, never satisfied. Nearest-wrong is an ungated burstCast shield re-apply.
Purely defensive, allies-except-self, 1x per battle. Asserts it never lands as a POSITIVE damageTakenPct on the boss — i.e. it was not misread as a damage-amplifying enemy debuff (failure-mode #4).

Asserts a burstGenPct=70.4 self buffApply exists, plus a counterfactual: stripping it cannot INCREASE burst casts. Fails if encoded as a generic damage buff or omitted (the unit is Burst I — gauge speed is her rotation payload).

Asserts atkPct=93.39 on self with no finite expiry ('continuously'), plus non-vacuity: removing it strictly lowers label total damage. Fails under a 'for N sec' duration misread and under a casterAtkPct mis-keying.

spec.kitLine: in Delusion: Electric dmg taken down
spec.assertion: Self defensive, continuous. Covered by the same no-positive-boss-debuff assertion; moves no damage.

THE load-bearing line, two discriminators. (a) STAT: 'of the skill user's ATK' = casterAtkPct, flat-resolved to 0.8036 x label.staticAtk and IDENTICAL across recipients — fails under atkPct, which emits the bare 80.36 and scales by each ally's own ATK. (b) TRIGGER: 'Shared Delusion' is introduced only in the BURST slot, so this is burst-cast-scoped for 10s — asserts one apply wave per label burst cast with expiresFrame-frame == 600, and explicitly that not every apply sits at frame 0. Fails under the nearest-wrong passive-from-t=0 model, which pays every ally for the full 180s.
Asserts label NEVER receives a casterAtkPct grant, and that stripping the grant leaves label's total byte-identical while strictly lowering at least one ally (target-set + inertness in one pair).

targetMaxHpPct on self, emitted flat under stat 'maxHpFlat' per the harness contract; asserts one apply per burst cast with a 10s window. Paired with an inertness test: label has no atkOfMaxHpPct line, so removing it must be damage-neutral (guards against a spurious HP->ATK conversion).

it.skip for the invulnerability itself (no shield HP pool, no boss damage — unobservable), BUT its real payload is asserted: every Shared Delusion ally grant must land on a frame where label cast her burst. This is what pins skill2c's trigger identity to this line.

fixtures: controlComp('label', true) for every run — liter B1 / crown B2 / label / helm B3, boss Fire, focus label. Rationale: label is Burst I, so she is the chain OPENER; the fixture must supply B2+B3 or no Full Burst ever completes and every burst-scoped assertion goes vacuous. Fixed-B3 left TRUE because label's own payload is self-ATK + a caster-scaled ally grant — neither is confounded by the fixed B3 slot's buffs, and the extra ally is needed as a Shared Delusion RECIPIENT to test the excludeSelf target set and the identical-flat-value property across recipients of differing ATK. Deterministic (no seed). 5 hoisted runComp calls (1 base + 4 counterfactuals), well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1b Delusion Shattered (untargetable + stun, up to 2 stacks) — trigger 'when Delusion status ends' is unreachable: the v1 boss deals no damage and nothing in the engine breaks a shield, so Delusion never ends.
skill1b Effect 1 Imagined Heartbreak untargetability — no primitive at all; the sim has no targeting/aggro model.
skill1c re-apply Delusion on normal attack while not in Delusion — 'not in Delusion' gate never satisfied (see above); must not be encoded ungated.
skill1d re-apply Delusion on Burst Skill while not in Delusion — same unreachable gate.
burst 'Shield becomes invulnerable for 10 sec' — no shield HP pool and no incoming boss damage, so invulnerability is unobservable; modelled indirectly via the 10s Shared Delusion window it opens.
skill2a allies Electric damage-taken reduction 70.4%/5s, and the skill2b self Electric damage-taken line — defensive only, no damage payload in a fight where the boss deals no damage.
